Takeru Daigo is a boy living in Tokyo who doesn't like milk. During summer vacation, he decides to go to Ushiojima by himself to visit his grandmother Tomi. Along with the help of his other milk friends who live on the island, Kevin makes it his mission to get Takeru to drink milk!

So, pull up a seat and have a drink—is shochu OK?

55640.description:
The anime takes place in 2006, and centers on Akio Hoshigami, who due to a leg injury is forced to give up on her dream of being a track-and-field star. Akio and her friend Ayano Umisoe move on to high school together. Amidst new activities and meeting new friends, Akio gradually starts acting like herself again. Then one day Ayano suddenly disappears.

(Source: Anime News Network)

55644.description:
Years ago, astronaut Byakuya left behind precious materials in the belief that his son, the scientifically-gifted Senkuu, would one day find them. In the present, the Kingdom of Science's Kohaku and Ginrou have infiltrated the harem of the Petrification Kingdom’s leader with the help of Amaryllis, a local girl. At first, their mission progresses without a hitch. Unfortunately, an error enacted by Kohaku and Ginrou leads Minister Ibara and the Island’s strongest warrior, Moz, to identify the intruding duo as enemies.

Even worse, Moz tails Amaryllis when she returns to inform Senkuu of the news, discovering the scientist's secret hideout. However, Moz's agenda does not align with Ibara's—he wants to dethrone the minister and keep the petrification device for himself. If Senkuu plays his cards right, he could gain a powerful ally and win the war once and for all.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

55655.description:
Meng Chuan witnessed his mother killed before his eyes, so he trained very hard hoping to one day avenge her death. But his peaceful days were broken as his wedding engagement being called off, an invasion by foreign forces, the sanctuary fallen into enemy hands… In order to protect the people of Ning City, he picked up his sword and vowed to be the strongest. This is a heavy responsibility and a long journey…

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

55657.description:
Xia Qiu, the young master of the Shenzhao Sect, returns to the country at the invitation of his elder brother Xia Chun, only to unexpectedly discover strange research in a secret chamber. To uncover Xia Chun's secrets, he ventures to Fuyu Pool, but is persecuted by his brother and forced into becoming a sacrifice to the ancient ferocious beast Feilian. By a twist of fate, Feilian resides within Xia Qiu's body, and he loses his original powers.

He is rescued by a chance encounter with a young girl named Long Yan. Upon waking, under the arrangement of Qing Chou, the acting head of the Long family, he disguises himself as Long Ze, the youngest son of the Long family, beginning a new life and adventure. Along the way, Long Ze encounters many companions and gradually experiences familial love and friendship he has never known before. The good times didn't last long. The immense power within him caused frequent crises, and the constantly emerging power struggles repeatedly injured or even killed his friends…

Ultimately, the ever-growing Long Ze reconciled with the power within him, successfully averting the greatest crisis and rescuing his companions who had been kidnapped by evil forces. However, the mysterious figure controlling the entire chessboard removed his mask, revealing himself to be his brother, Xia Chun, and even greater mysteries began to gather…

(Source: IQIYI, translated)

55659.description:
The residents of Jewel Forest, Jewel Teeniepings suddenly disappeared. Joahping, Teeheeping, and Trustping, who also are Jewel Teeniepings, the students of Royal Teenieping Academy, and the candidates of next Royal Teeniepings, head to Earth to save their friends…
Now, Romi and Heartsping have to team up with Joahping, Teeheeping, and Trustping, three immature Royal Teeniepings. Will Romi be able to find 15 lost Jewel Teeniepings and catch?

(Source: SAMG Entertainment)

55660.description:
Secret Key teeniepings appear in Harmony Town!

And there’s a mysterious secret teenieping too! Will Romi and the new Royal teeniepings be able to catch all the Key Teeniepings scattered in Harmony Town and reveal the identity of the mysterious secret Teenieping?

(Source: SAMG Entertainment)

55689.description:
First-year high school student, Uta Komaki. She has many weaknesses. But she loves to sing. Aiming for an ordinary youth, she tries to join the light music club as part of her high school debut—only to fail miserably due to her timid nature.

In her despair, Uta encounters a form of music created solely by the human voice—a cappella. There, she finds a group of girls whose imperfect youth is woven together only through their harmonized voices. —Even without shining, it's still youth.

(Source: Pony Canyon)

55690.description:
After an eventful winter break, Kyoutarou Ichikawa and Anna Yamada reunite with a stronger bond. They continue to grow in their own ways, with Yamada taking on more challenging photoshoots and Ichikawa maturing both physically and emotionally as he tackles his affections for Yamada. However, spending time together outside of school allows for their relationship to deepen, and it becomes increasingly difficult to deny their budding romantic feelings.

Grappling with these unexpected and new emotions, Ichikawa and Yamada realize that, with the passage of time, their relationship is bound to change—and they must ultimately decide whether they wish to remain close friends or finally become a couple.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

55691.description:
Based on the CG collection by Aomizuan (青水庵).

The main character, Seiichi, enjoys traveling to remote islands and is a teacher by profession. He is a teacher, and is a man of immense sexual prowess, but he is not satisfied with his daily life. One day, he receives a request from the chief of an island he knows. He is transferred to a remote island called Koumi-jima, also known as Childbirth Island.

The "favor" was...
The women of this island have evolved a unique constitution, with only one week between implantation and birth, due to the island's custom of specializing in the role of females, and have continued to thrive in their own unique way for hundreds of years. It seemed as if the island would continue to prosper at this rate, but because the islanders have been mixing only close genes among themselves, it has come to the point where only genes from outside the island can be used to produce the newborns.

The island chief's request was for Seiichi, an immensely fertile man with an outside gene: "I want you to impregnate all the girls on the island"
That's what it was!

The island's custom of specializing in the role of the female, the women want to satisfy the instincts of the men, who from the bottom of their hearts have the idea of male superiority. What will happen to the women who feel the supreme pleasure in pleasing men and giving birth to children when Seiichi appears on the scene??

Note: It has live-action AV adaptations: NIMA-049 (2025/01/31) and NIMA-050 (2025/02/28).

55694.description:
In an ancient time when powerful Cultivators constantly battle for supremacy, a young man nicknamed Sleepyhead acquires a matchlessly powerful Cultivation method which has come as a blessing in disguise. That day marks the start of an epic journey of a prodigy endowed with unequaled physical constitution, who later achieves a meteoric rise in the world of Cultivators by defeating countless talented fellow practitioners. In a realm where numerous forces are thriving, he alone stands invincible.
(Source: Youku)
